en: Sepia-toned historic image showing a single-storey wooden pavilion or villa with a tiled roof, decorative gables, and shuttered windows, set in a landscaped park. A pond in the foreground reflects the entire building and surrounding trees. Several men, women, and children in early-20th‑century clothing stand or walk along the edge of the pond. Tall palm trees and other lush vegetation surround the structure, giving a subtropical or tropical feel. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.
